title: Build the shared MUI account forms
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Adapt the v6 MUI templates for sign-in, signup and reset. Use the captured CodeSlots control for the six-digit invite and member-reset codes. Share the server identity, field labels, password visibility, autofill and async feedback.

**Verify** · Verify keyboard submission, six-digit paste and entry, the error drain and clear, the success lock, focus after an error, narrow layout, password-manager fields, reduced motion and double-submit handling. Record the reused components.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-057

**Queue** · Follows WI-057 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
